description: Source file implementing Babel transformation utilities for handling JavaScript/TypeScript code, including configuration of Babel plugins and parsing/transforming code.

methods.name: babelTransformOptions
methods.description: Generates Babel transform options based on whether the input is TypeScript, module type, and plugin configurations.

methods.name: isTypeScript
methods.description: Checks if the filename indicates a TypeScript file based on its extension.

methods.name: babelTransform
methods.description: Transforms code using Babel with specified plugins and options, preventing reentrant calls.

methods.name: babelParse
methods.description: Parses code into Babel's AST format with specified options.
